sessions.title: Psalms and Proverbs Verse Endings
sessions.theme: Complete familiar KJV passages from Psalms and Proverbs.

rounds.title: Psalm 1:1
rounds.verseStart: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly,
rounds.correctEnding: nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.
choices: nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.
but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
and a light unto my path.
a very present help in trouble.
rounds.teachingNote: The blessed life is described by what a person refuses and what he follows.

rounds.title: Psalm 1:3
rounds.verseStart: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water,
rounds.correctEnding: that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
choices: that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
and a light unto my path.
a very present help in trouble.
for out of it are the issues of life.
rounds.teachingNote: Psalm 1 pictures faithful meditation as a rooted and fruitful life.

a very present help in trouble.
for out of it are the issues of life.
the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
